original_card.question: Can a literal QQ16 producer meet the proposed completed-output error budgets with dirty helpers and an affordable physical consumer?
methods: Derive one literal producer's completed-output defects and intermediate dirty-helper bounds, with its physical bill.
Design or audit one consumer, retention or hosting boundary and its complete cost for the pinned producer/decoder.
original_card.acceptance_gate: Name the changed premise of the fixed F0/B1 observation obstruction. Show exactly which query is recovered, legal native reads and restoration, and a full favorable budget including cover maps, helpers and endpoints. Local inverse identities alone do not close the global controller. A scoped local result may be retained without a complete supplier. Expanding it into further construction rounds requires the family-level budget and obligation gate in research-family-status.md; an optimistic passing relaxation alone is not acceptance.

first_step.inspect: Read the revision-6 family record and #2965 producer-defect transfer after the local QQ16 decoder contract. Its author-checked output-error estimate does not implement producer interiors, bound dirty helpers, or pay for the consumer; independently check the implication used.
first_step.scope: Source-bound orientation only. Read the named package and review before relying on its local evidence; this command is not its replay or supplier admission.

original_card.first_experiment: Pin one literal F0/B1 producer and its native-child contracts; derive the actual intermediate magnitude ledger and completed-output defects, including dirty helpers and correlations. Compare with #2965 budgets and price storage, movement, cleanup and F17 consumption. Stop with a precise missing bound if no producer contract supplies it; do not optimize another decoder precision constant in isolation.
original_card.bottleneck_link: The native local words exist; retained query information and its physical access are the missing link to a composed recursive interface.
allowed_variations: One paid query, one changed first pair, or one precisely specified affine helper state.
A counterexample or lower bound for that exact proposed repair.
One unresolved obligation of a newer local decoder, with exact source heads and a distinct claim/domain.
scope_change_triggers: Retaining the fixed first pair and ordinary schedule while allowing only homogeneous selected-only control, already excluded by the witness.
Treating cover-map counts as zero-cost physical address operations.
Recreating the pending complete local decoder or early-record/output-bank coalescing already under investigation without a distinct audit or changed premise.
Treating a completed-output defect inequality as a producer-interior, dirty-range or physical-cost certificate.

actual_scope: All-positive-common-tensor-depth component-grid/range induction for the literal full-cover F0 then B_1_2 arithmetic reference, carried dirty state and numeric density
scope_change_reason: PR3270 explicitly restricts its native-interior envelope to one tensor layer. This package proves the lambda-dependent implementation-domain implication, without another decoder/inverse constant or a physical caller claim.
bottleneck_link: A completed producer error allowance does not supply finite component formats. This closes that numerical reference gap uniformly in tensor depth, leaving actual caller entry grid and complete physical/consumer costs explicit.
stop_rule: Stop after the all-depth source-bound grid/range implication or a missing tensor-native premise; no further construction round.
evidence: PROOF.md; RESULT.json; exact one-layer trace; numeric depths1,2,3,8; five control groups; CHECKS.json
